fusions.name: Chill Ripple
fusions.desc: A cold ripple that deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns each for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Slow Lash
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 6 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Left Behind
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Basking Spot
fusions.desc: By day, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
